title: Florida man arrested for smashing up Arby’s weeks after leaving prison for ‘hunting’ swan for ‘food’
comment: Less than a month out of jail for killing and eating a swan at Lake Eola, he allegedly put an Arby's window through, then the Dunkin' sign next door, then a bank ATM. Police say the tour continued down East Colonial Drive, where he threw a pipe at passing cars.
excerpt: Florida man arrested for smashing up Arby’s weeks after leaving prison for ‘hunting’ swan for ‘food’ New York Post

title: Florida man allegedly stole mortuary stretchers from funeral homes in Alabama, multiple states
comment: Someone had been working through funeral homes across four states, and what he was after was the stretchers — over $12,000 of mortuary equipment from two Ozark parlors alone. A Florida man was arrested as the operator of the ring.
excerpt: Florida man allegedly stole mortuary stretchers from funeral homes in Alabama, multiple states AL.com

title: Exclusive | California man slams city after being fined for growing food at home: ‘I don’t trust the system’
comment: A Chino man turned his front lawn into a working food garden — sweet potatoes, sugar cane, bananas, passion fruit — and the city declared it a nuisance. The first fine was $750, with another $500 queued up if the dandelions stay.
excerpt: Exclusive | California man slams city after being fined for growing food at home: ‘I don’t trust the system’ New York Post

title: Watch: Virginia woman wakes to find bat on her mouth
comment: A Richmond doctor woke at 6 a.m. dreaming that a field mouse was crawling into her mouth, then found the dream was a bat and it was real. She folded its wings back with her bare hand; it later tested negative for rabies.
excerpt: A Virginia doctor shared the unusual story of how she recently woke up in her home to find a bat attempting to get into her mouth.

title: Florida man, 83, accused of taking saw palmetto berries illegally
comment: An 83-year-old was arrested for helping himself to saw palmetto berries he had no permit to pick. In Florida the shrub is protected enough that berry-picking is a felony.
excerpt: Florida man, 83, accused of taking saw palmetto berries illegally Treasure Coast News

title: Neighbors file lawsuit against Orlando HOA over financial concerns
comment: Neighbors are suing their Orlando homeowners association over where exactly the money has been going. The association's books are now a matter for the court.
excerpt: Neighbors file lawsuit against Orlando HOA over financial concerns FOX 35 Orlando
